library(shiny)
runApp(list(
            ui =  basicPage(
                               selectInput('modelos',
                                           '',
                                           c('Linear' = 'lin',
                                             'Other' = 'outro')),
                               # Mostrar somente quando o modelo for outro
                               conditionalPanel(
                                                condition = "input.modelos == 'outro'",
                                                textInput('yourmodel',
                                                          '',
                                                          'a + b*x + c*x^2')),
                               conditionalPanel(
                                                condition = "input.modelos == 'lin'",
                                                numericInput('lin_minb0',
                                                             'Minimum to b0',
                                                             1),
                                                numericInput('lin_maxb0',
                                                             'Maximum to b0',
                                                             4),
                                                uiOutput('sliderlinb0'),
                                                numericInput('lin_minb1',
                                                             'Minimum para b1',
                                                             0.1),
                                                numericInput('lin_maxb1',
                                                             'Maximum para b1',
                                                             0.8),
                                                uiOutput('sliderlinb1')),

                               conditionalPanel(
                                                condition = "input.modelos == 'outro'",

                                                uiOutput('inputMin'),
                                                uiOutput('inputMax'),
                                                uiOutput('dyn_output'))
                                                ),
            server = function(input, output) {

             # Deslisadores para a função linear
             output$sliderlinb0 <- renderUI({
              sliderInput("insllb0", "Parameter b0", min=input$lin_minb0, max=input$lin_maxb0, value=input$lin_minb0)
             })
             output$sliderlinb1 <- renderUI({  
              sliderInput("insllb1", "Parameter b1", min=input$lin_minb1, max=input$lin_maxb1, value=input$lin_minb1)
             })

             # Obtendo os parâmetros

parameters <- reactive({

              expression1 <- grep('[[:alpha:]]',
                                  unlist(strsplit(input$yourmodel,

'[[:punct:]]')),
                                  value=T)
              expression2 <- c(grep('[[:alpha:]]{2,}',
                                    expression1,
                                    value=T),
                               grep('x',
                                    expression1,
                                    value=T))
              setdiff(expression1,
                      expression2)
             })
# Número de parâmetros

nparameters <- reactive({
              length(parameters())
             })

# Criando os outputs para valores mínimos

             output$inputMin <- renderUI({
              inputs1 <- lapply(1:nparameters(), function(i) {
                                input_nameMIN <- paste("Minimo_para", i, sep=" ")
                                start_valMIN <- isolate(input[[input_nameMIN]])
                                if(is.null(start_valMIN)){
                                 start_valMIN <- i
                                }

                                numericInput(input_nameMIN, label = input_nameMIN, value = start_valMIN)

})
              #Put the inputs into a taglist

do.call(tagList, inputs1)
             })

             # Criando os outputs para valrores máximos          
             output$inputMax <- renderUI({
              inputs2 <- lapply(1:nparameters(), function(i) {
                                input_nameMAX <- paste("Maximo_para", i, sep=" ")
                                start_valMAX <- isolate(input[[input_nameMAX]])
                                if(is.null(start_valMAX)){
                                 start_valMAX <- i
                                }

                                numericInput(input_nameMAX, label = input_nameMAX, value = start_valMAX)

})

              #Put the inputs into a taglist

do.call(tagList, inputs2)
             })

             #Criando os deslisadores
             output$dyn_output <- renderUI({
              outputs <- lapply(1:nparameters(), function(i) {
                                output_name <- paste("Parâmetro",i, sep=" ")                             
                                sliderInput(output_name,
                                            label = output_name,
                                            min = input[[input_nameMIN]],
                                            max = input[[input_nameMAX]],
                                            value = input[[input_nameMIN]])

})

              # Convert the list to a tagList - necessary for it to show

do.call(tagList, outputs)
             })
            }
            ))
